He was extremely nice but I found his lectures too quiet. I sometimes had trouble hearing him, especially through his accent. I also thought that the course content was interesting but he didn't make it terribly exciting

Wonderful professor.  A night class with prof Vinh is the best way to end the day!  He's so knowledgeable on Japanese history, and having a minimal background in the language really helps in the class.

He's a prof who tries to ease your mind in his class since he considers the rest of university life as stressful enough. He adds to this by not having a research paper for his 300 level courses. His knowledge of Japanese, Chinese, and Korean history is impeccable.

Incredibly knowledgeable about Japanese History and very respected internationally in his field.  He's an amazing person.  Very long-winded about off-topics, but will only test what he's said in class.  Tells you exactly what will be on exam.

He knows the content VERY well.  English is his 3rd language, so you have to cut him some slack on his thick accent.  Once you learn to get past that, its a great course with a pretty easy exam (he tells you ahead of time EXACTLY what will be tested).
I WENT TO THREE CLASSES ALL SEMESTER AND GOT A 7!!! ONE LECTURE, ONE MIDTERM AND ONE FINAL!!!! I don't even remember what he looks like!!!
Very nice, but hard to follow. Only tests on stuff he has the time to talk about.

I got a B in this class in spite of him. Very unclear and never went by the book. Always opted to show the class his way of doing things which was always entirely too difficult. I had to learn on the fly in this class because of the way he taught.
Good

Attend class for extra credit. Exams are somewhat hard & make you apply concepts.  He is super stingy with points, will show up lat and doesn't care. Im ending the class with a B+ by .57..... Takes forever to post grades and checked out by the last week.. He makes you work for your grade.  Frustrating!! 80% of grade is purely exams. Paper was easy.

EC if you attend class (8 pts- each Exam). He reads off the slides in class, comes late, and didn't show up on the first day. He tries to be funny in class which can be a plus, but he's very stingy with EC points. Summer class is fast paced but if you go to class you will pass. Aplia(HW) 3 attemps & Essay (pass/fail) are easy. Grades take forever.

Vinh is a great professor. If you go to class and listen to him lecture you should be able to get an A easily. He gives a great review before each midterm that covers whats on the test perfectly.  5 weeks left in the semester and i currently have an A+

Vinh is actually a bit tougher on tests and hw but he ended up "curving" to compensate. The final is departmental so it was easier then his own tests. He has an accent but he tries very hard to be clear and make concepts easy to understand, be patient and go to class. Realize some of these concepts are generalized for instruction.

I am not good at math but after I took Vinh's class, I got back my confidence on math. He is a patient professor and he makes complicated stuff simpler and clear; thus, although you are not good at math, you still can understand what he is teaching about. Quizzes and Exams are from the lectures, handout and review he gave. Highly recommended!!

WOW! I am horrible at math (really I always failed it) until I took Vinh. He made everything so simple and easy to understand but you really have to take good notes and pay attention. This class was laid back. Careful when you choose a group for group projects because they can really screw your grade over!! :(

He is a great professor. His lectures may be heavy because they go really fast. A lot of group work. The material is straight out of the textbook. We used textbook only for homework problems so an online version is enough. Sometimes he hands out extra credit surveys so don't miss his classes. All quizzes are EC. Tests are 95% of grade.

He is absolutely incredible ! I cannot even begin to describe how much I adored taking Calculus 1 with him. His explanations are outstanding and he is always willing to re-explain if needed. Despite class not being mandatory, if you go, he explains so well that you do not even need to study for exams. This is a MUST TAKE PROFESSOR!!

Vinh is very organized, and hands out his lecture notes at the beginning of each chapter with examples that we do in class. I think the language barrier is hard for him, I noticed he is not sure how to explain your question in a different way than how he already lectured the material. All quizzes are extra credit and given a cheat sheet for exams.

He tries to make the course understandable for students with different majors. The tests are fairly easy as long as you do the homework. He gave us one extra credit opportunity which was fun. He converts your lowest exam score with the score you receive in the final exam. He makes the students work in groups to solve problems and helps us if needed

Professor Nguyen was a great math teacher. We had lots of opportunities for extra credit. We were also allowed to drop our lowest test score. He is fair and gives clear grading criteria. Make sure you do the homework as it carries the same amount of points as the quizzes.

Vinh is a nice guy and will do a lot to help students pass. He may be hard to understand at some points because of his accent, but he explains things very clearly. I suggest this class for anyone who needs to pass trigonometry.
Great teacher! I like how the quizzes came directly from the homework, and the exams were freaking similar to the exam reviews he posted on WebAccess.

if it wouldn't for his generosity on the final, i would surely fail the course. He used his final to made up for one exam that I did badly on. His exams followed the guideline he posted on Webaccess. He gave out 6-7 extra credits quizzes, which helps a lot too. A nice professor.

Nice instructor! He assigned lots of hw and a lot of group work. He and his SI leader were very helpful. Tests are pretty easy because they are similar to the review. Attend class lecture, do hw, and do the review before each exam, and you will pass this class no problem. Would love to take him again.
He is very difficult to understand and does not put in any effort to explain things twice if he needed to.

Vinh is the best math professor I have yet had at UARK so far. He truly wants to make sure students succeed and he has a great grading scale. He is an easy professor and understands how to teach the difficult content very well
Great professor taught the material very well :)

No quizzes, get to drop an exam (final screwed me), gets much harder as the semester goes on so make sure to get good grades on the first 2-3 exams. Ez clap, hw is worth 25% of the grade so take it seriously.

Just practice as much as possible with the "Extra Study" in MML if you need help. His reviews are close to what you will see on the exam it helps to focus on what he hands out. Test1&2 are your best chance for getting an A or B+. 3rd test to me was the hardest. The final exam was comprehensive 6qst. from last exam, 6 from the rest of the semester.

i dont know what to say but he's the goat for math at hunter. at first i was afraid i wasn't going to do so well but ended up doing excellent. his lectures are outstanding and his notes are very clear. sometimes he may not fulfil his promises but his exams are easy and there's no way you can fail. just do me a favour and enrol into his classes.

felt like I was on crack during his class. I don't know how he got this job. would make a great comedian but felt like I  was laughing at him the entire time. genuinely confused. class is very easy though. expect he would change what the test was asking during it without informing anyone. would leave his class baffled daily.
Amazing dude, always kept the class interested and just genuinely a good guy, really easy to get A+ in class, just show up and study the reviews

Made learning statistics very easy and understandable. Gives classwork assignments that are used as extra credit on exams. Does review sessions before each upcoming exam and literally tells you what type of questions will be on them, so don't skip lectures!!!

Prof Vinh is easygoing and makes the student experience as easy as possible. There are 3 exams and students can bring a sheet of notes on each exam to help. Content can be difficult but if you study, you will do well. Homework is easy and not overbearing. He teaches fast-paced and can be difficult to understand, but will re-explain if you ask.

For a stats prof, he was more than fair. I ended with a B+ in the class, HW (for all stats classes) are due at the end of the semester. Super lenient, Classwork given & 3 exams. Exams are worth a lot. Hes kind & not the worst lecturer. You cant go wrong with him. Some concepts he teaches better than other concepts. Has thick accent, sit in front

Professor Vinh Ly makes things easy to understand, his class is very straightforward, no bs about how or why the math was made, just how to do it, so if you aren't a stats major and just need the credit, this is the way to go. His reviews of his tests are very similar to the actual tests. Homework was on a website, and you have to pay ~$90 though.

Stat is a pretty boring subject but this prof is very funny and keeps us engaged. His lectures consist of solving problems similar to those on the test so if you pay attention you should be fine. Be aware though because there might be one or two qs not touched upon in class so do homeworks as well. DO NOT LEAVE HW FOR THE LAST MOMENT.

Goated Professor what more can I say Professor Ly is really the best stats professor in my opinion he does a great job in helping you understand the material. He made all the exams online and made the class a smooth experience. I never thought I would have done as well as I did if I was not apart of his class.

Professor Ly is the best professor I had my first year of college. Even though it was a Saturday class I looked forward to his lectures. He is really funny and he tries his best to simply the material as much as possible. If you pay attention in class and take notes you should receive at least a B. The tests are worth 80% and hw 20%. Recommended!!!
he is very chill, and funny, honestly stat is boring but he makes it fun. His class is in person but he makes the exams online so you know what that means!

The course is easy to ace and what not! I just don't like how he's moves like he's understanding yet makes sneaky moves (he extended the HW assignment till the day before final grades were due without telling anyone causing me to have a C+. He basically sabotaged my chance of getting a B or acing the course). Not all professors wants to see you win
Awesome professor but you do have to put in the leg work. He made a difficult topic easy to understand.

He doesn't explain topics in depth & just shows you how to solve the questions. The HW's are nothing related to what he teaches, so you have to spend an extra 2-3 hrs reading the textbook to understand them. The final had 1-2 questions we never learned how to do, but overall it wasn't bad. You'll pass but wouldn't rec. if your majoring in stats

Amazing professor whose lectures will reflect similar to his exams and weekly homework assignments. His lectures are key to doing well on his exams and homeworks so dont miss any days!! Made the math he was teaching fun and enjoyable to learn and do. Take him if you can because you'll have an A if you pay attention and do well on his exams!!

Professor Ly lays the whole course out for you in the syllabus and follows it to the T. He gives homeworks which are fair as long as you take good notes in lecture. Do all the homeworks, review sheets for exams and you should be able to pull a B+ to an A+. Try to be on time with submissions, it helps!

Super nice guy. Do the 50 question review sheets and ull do amazing. Before the exam like right before he used to spend an hour going over review packet which he pulls all questions from and used to drop hints on what questions would pop up. Cengage hw can be lot dont save for end of semester. Dont skip class and pay attention please else u behind

Professor Ly is a very easy going. He has an accent, however you it is very easy to understand him. One thing that is very important is that you must show up to class in order to pass. He is a very easy grader. The review sheet given before an exam is very helpful, and he gives extra credit on exams.

Pretty heavy accent so beware. Great prof, hes nice and always answers questions. he shows the work step by step for questions and his study guides are like 50Q so if u do all, youll def get 85+. Just do the study guides and do the hw and its an easy B+ or above.

I thought he was a decent prof, but I had a previous grasp of the material. If you remember nothing from high school math classes, you'd probably get lost between how fast he goes and that sometimes it's hard to understand his accent. But if you ask him to go over something again, he will. The TAs are helpful. I hated having online homework though

He is available outside class, is a very lenient grader, gives extra credit and drops the lowest grade. Two tests and the final plus online homework that is due by the end of the term. Exam questions are the same than the ones he teaches in class or taken from the review sheet.

do yourself a favor and don't take him. everyone who took him for stat113 got a C, his class is unnaturally hard, I took it again with someone else and got a B+. you can't ask him one thing without him talking about something or the words "go read the textbook" coming from his mouth

You mainly do homework and quizzes online, while the tests in class. There are 5 tests throughout the semester (including the final). You can't redo the tests however he drops the lowest grade at the end of the semester and is VERY understanding about homework, if you didn't have time to do it all you have to do is email him and ask to reopen it!
One of the easiest graders. You will pass if you show up to his lectures but its not mandatory. Usually extends due dates and gives partial credit for many tests and quizzes.

Observation: He speaks in plural. (Ex. "If you want to pass EXAMS THREES, you must do the WORKS.") Just something I observed.. He gives a lot of online hw. He's a lenient grader though, he'll give so much partial credit on the exams. His review sheets mirror the exams, which is amazing! Go to class, pay attention, and you should be fine.

Highly recommend taking! He offers a lot of help and is very caring. The review sheets reflect the exams accurately. A lot of partial credit is given on exams. He often extended MyMathLab deadlines. Classwork is given every class, it counts as attendance, but it can be due next class if you don't finish. Always willing to answer questions.

Worst professor in the entire world. No exaggeration. He doesn't teach and you need to learn  everything yourself.  In his mind an 85 is equal to a C. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS! I never thought that I would leave a bad review for a professor but goodness does he deserve it!

Very lenient with his grading policy. If you study the topic outside of class and come prepared, he will clear up any issues you have. Make sure to get his attention if you have a question! He has a tendency to move a bit fast and may skip over a difficult question after answering it in class.

I would've dropped this class earlier if I realized ahead of time he's that bad... Doesn't explain anything. You can ask him a question and he strays off topic or goes on to talk about something else.

Agreed, the best professor in statistics.  Explains a normally dry, difficult subject from different easier angles.  Also very patient in answering student questions and will review the same concepts in different ways until the class understands.  Tests are fair and similar to hw.  Also curves generously.  Also answers email quickly and in detail.

He was an excellent professor who explained a difficult subject in ways that make sense.  The hw and tests reinforced the lecture videos and straightforward if you watch the lectures.  The tests are already fair and on top of that he gives curves based on how the class does.  Also, very prompt with helping over email and scheduling online meetings

I took this class after withdrawing from another teacher's class.  I didn't learn anything in the other class because the other teacher was just reading from the book and unable to answer questions on why things are.  I needed this class for calculus and engineering.  This prof cares patiently answers all questions and cares about real learning

This is a professor who deeply understands the material, not reading from powerpoints or from the book, as well as caring that students are actually learning.  The homework and exams are straightforward from the lectures, and any questions I had were answered quickly over email.  Didn't plan on any taking any math classes after this but will now.

The best math teacher I've ever had.  Patiently answered every question from multiple angles so that students can understand.  Knows the material like the back of his hand and is always patient to review past material while explaining current question.  Also, met with me many times for office hours and teams meetings.  Goes above and beyond

He spends the first hour going over hw questions, so we didn't get much time to learn new stuff. We didn't even finish the entire course by the semester end. He inserted some scantrons wrong, which led to some students getting WRONG GRADES. This turned 1 of my classmates 80 into a 20. We had to bring it up to him. Does NOT respond outside class.

He is extremely knowledgeable and also patient and caring.  He always answers student questions patiently and reviews previous material while he answers questions.  He teaches so that students can understand why and not just remember the material.  Some of the material I saw in a previous class but actually understand it now

If you do what you are supposed to do, the class is easy and you will learn a lot.  He explains the big picture with a depth that other teachers are not able to do.  He is knowledgeable and patient in answering questions and answered my questions over email promptly and in depth

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!! I have never written a review on here, but this time I had to. This is possibly the WORST professor at EFSC. His lectures are nothing like his homework or tests and each test is worth 25% of your grade. No extra credit is given, and he does not respond to emails until weeks later. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

His lectures are really good and hw reinforces the lectures.  If you pay attention in class and do hw without just clicking on the answers, then you will do well in the class.  His email responses to questions about how to do problems were prompt and detailed.  He also made extra time to meet the beyond the posted office hours.  Very caring prof.

I was failing the ENTIRE semester. Only three tests the whole semester and homework barely helps your grade. Does not care about his students. I feel like I learned nothing. Most of the students were failing each of the tests which had to be heavily curved.
Class was pretty cut and dry, read the textbook and do the practice questions through MyLab. Tests were very heavily weighted (25% each) but they came from the same question bank as the hw.

My problem with learning math in the past is I never saw what the point of learning it was.  He has a whole lecture on day one talking about that.  He really stresses understanding every step, why it is that way, and what the main point is.  He really is the best to truly learn and understand.  His exams are fair and similar to the homework.
Best math teacher I have ever had, hands down.  Emphasized understanding and thinking and got me to get the point of all the equations.  Def take him if you actually want to learn.

I would say if your taking this class to know that he does not do a great job a teaching and often makes mistakes. His homework can be challenging and the test and difficult. Every test we had got some kind of curve the biggest being a 20% curve
Grade relies heavily on 3 honor lock tests. No matter if you pass all the homework you must pass the tests to pass the class. NO EXTRA CREDIT. Not friendly.

Class was well organized.  Video lectures were quite helpful and focused on understanding the big picture.  They are the length of a class lecture, about 40 minutes and not a bite sized online video.  Homework reinforces the lectures, and exams are similar to homework.  He is also responsive with email and gives detailed help and explanations.

This class and professor are the best for students who want to learn and understand the material.  His lectures make it easy to understand the big picture and then the details are honed in.  Exams are very similar to the hw, which have unlimited attempts.  The professor is also very prompt with responding to questions and gives detailed responses

Took this class online, every test was heavily curved because of the low scores everyone would get. He would assign entire chapters to do in one week despite the in-person classes being way behind us. The videos he would upload to canvas would be extremely hard to hear and you can barely see what he's writing on the whiteboard. Would not recommend.

This is the first math teacher I have ever had that focuses on real understanding and not just throwing formulas around.  He has a deep understanding of the subject and cares that students truly understand.  He responds to questions over email promptly and schedules long Teams meetings sessions to discuss the class material until I truly understood

I have never before struggled with math until I took Professors Nghiems class. All I can say is that whatever you do absolutely do not take him as your professor choose literally anyone else. He grades on a curve and verbatim designs his tests for you to fail. He's a nice guy but a terrible teacher. Lectures were impossible to understand. Goodluck.

The lectures and homework examples are too easy compared to the wording of the questions in his tests. The tests also include sections of knowledge that he doesn't cover, or if he does cover them, it's very simplistic. This makes it challenging to apply that knowledge to the test nearly all of the time. The lecture videos are terrible.

Very knowledgeable and caring professor. I took this class with another professor in the past, who just read from slides and the book, and was awful. This professor's classes are basically like telling interesting and engaging stories to present the material and it is very easy to understand the big picture. He is also very generous with curving.

Dr. Vinh Nghiem's teaching falls short. Lectures lack organization, making learning impossible. Random math problems are thrown without structure, leaving students unable to comprehend. Tests seem designed for failure. Avoid his class for a better learning experience.

He's wicked smart, understands the subject inside and out, and cared whether students were learning. I asked a lot of questions over email and always got detailed responses.  He also always made time when I needed direct interaction and scheduled online meetings.  I ended up really understanding the subject deeply after having him as a professor

Decent professor. I took him for online STA2023 and the hardest part was the homework. It was time consuming!  The tests are proctored, and the final is cumulative. His videos are kinda hard to understand, so all in all, he is an okish professor and wouldn't really take him again. 
.

Nghiem is very charismatic .The class can be boring at times because you are just doing examples but I would say it's not any more or less boring than any other math class I have taken. There is regular homework assignments, I would say 2-4 per week. All assignments are on MyMathLab, the program itself is annoying but he is always willing to help.

Homework is 20%, tests 75%, and discussion boards 5% of grade. HW is time consuming but you should be able to get 100% on each one. DB are due at end of semester. Tests are difficult, open note/book. Final exam includes all chapters. Curves heavy on tests. Video lectures are hard to hear. Communication is hit or miss with how fast he responds.

Genuinely wants his students to pass, and will spend the whole class answering questions if needed. Although there is a lot of homework and it is worth 25% of your grade, the test grades have the biggest impact. Initially I was incredibly scared to take this class cuz of the statistics horror stories I heard math isn't my strong suit. He made a seemingly hard class easy to comprehend. The tests were difficult, but he generously curves them. Attendance isn't entirely necessary, but encouraged (he has vid lectures). Always ask questions in class

I took this class as a transient student over the summer here at this college and it was really easy and clear what was on tests and such, the only thing was because the summer session is so sort not all the material was covered but the homework "filled in all the gaps" as he would say. If you need or want help, he is really good at providing it.

Somewhat easy class, long lectures posted as youtube videos, but they cover pretty much everything you need to know. The homework is usually short and simple. The tests were proctored with honorlock but were open note and book. He also grades the tests with a curve. There were some simple discussion boards all due by the end of the semester.

Actually uploads full-length lecture vids for students. HW lessons are very short (make sure you go back and practice concepts in the study plan before tests cuz you'll forget). The 3 tests are all open book/open note. Generous curves on test grades. 6 DBs only due at the very end of the course.

This professor has improved a lot. The online Stat class was definitely the best online math class at EFSC. The professor provides detailed lectures on all material, PowerPoints, and is accessible to help with material. Three HonorLock tests are annoying, but Nghiem provides a generous 20%-25% curve. Usually 2-3 short MyLab HWs weekly.

Two Tests (ea. 25%)Final exam25%.HW is 20% DB 5%. Curves grades.
Pre-record lectures could use update. responsive to emails but explaining through email text was not helpful. I used brainfuse tutors which is hit/miss. Searching YT for problems shows statcrunch to solve but he doesn't allow this on tests. Take in person if you have doubts.

I LOVE this professor for one reason: I have always failed math classes until his class. He explains it so clearly and you can ask a bunch of questions. I noticed he doesn't move on if you are still confused, he is patient and will give multiple examples. Don't show up for class, then don't expect to pass. He's really funny too. Taking him again.

He did a great job teaching a difficult subject and lectures were fun. Tests are ridiculously difficult even though they are open book and open notes. Exams are heavily curved thankfully. DO THE HOMEWORK. I had a 4.0gpa before this class and was just happy to pass. He has study sessions after almost every class and you should go to them.

Weekly homework, 6 discussion posts, 3 tests. Dr. Nghiem graded on a curve which is what saved me from having to retake this online class. He provided his lectures for each module which helped understanding the concepts. Statistics was very difficult for me but Dr. Nghiem responded to every email and was always available to help when needed.

I took Prof. Nghiem's class online at first and failed. Then I took it in person, and I did a lot better. The lectures make a difference. He teaches easier ways to do things than the book does. The HW is minimal, about 2-10 questions. I am not a fan of MyMathLab, the tests/HW are on there, but there is a curve for tests and they're open note.

Dr. Nghiem was unbelievably helpful. Stats is hard, but he provided real class recordings and note slides, which are more helpful than the actual textbook. If you reach out to him, he responds & will set up a virtual meeting to work through problems. You *MUST* study, practice, review, and work hard. Grading curves help! Suggested calc: TI-36X PRO

Very clearly a teacher who knows how to properly teach a subject. He knows how to convey the subject matter to his students in a clear manner and assigns homework that is relevant and easy to complete. A good math professor for someone who may not be the best with math (or for someone who is).

Simply put, I would not have passed without his help. He was very kind, helpful, and thoughtful when it came to a struggling student, and his meetings were always pleasant. Amazing teacher, would take again if I could.

All of the work is online through Mathlab. He does not communicate, but he will respond if you reach out. You will teach yourself completely. The work load is pretty heavy, about 4 assignments a week with 40 questions on each. All 3 tests are proctored, be prepared to know the material.

Get the proper calculator (TI83/84). This will help tremendously. Reach out for help! Any time I felt lost I sent an email to set up a 1-1. His knowledge and understanding of the subject matter is deep & vast. You will have to put in A LOT of work. Test heavy, but the curve helped. 25% of grade is HW, so just do it. Use all Pearson resources!

Do not take this teacher!!! Professor Nghiem sets you up for failure!! You have to teach yourself everything. DO NOT take his class. You have to pay for a textbook AND an access code, to then teach yourself everything. Be ready to teach yourself everything, 50+ HW assignments and three proctored tests. There is literally no study guide or prep for the tests, so you better hope you studied the right thing. The final is cumulative. Skip this and go to College Algebra, its not worth it. Silver lining: Does grant a generous 15% curve on tests since most people fail.

I took his class online and if you are good at math go for it but I dont recommend taking this class online at all unless you can teach yourself. I took this course before with an atrocious professor who just read from the book and didn't seem like she actually understood it herself. Night and day difference with this professor. Great professor. I had hated math all my life until I had this professor. Has a deep understanding of the material and is able to make difficult ideas clear and accessible. He continued to schedule extra appointments to talk and depth about concepts and answered my questions patiently.
This professor is a good professor. The work is hard but as long as you get a tutor to help you you will be okay, also make sure you study!

I can't speak to his in-person classes, but DO NOT take his online statistics course. I put in close to 40 hours on his homework. Professor expects too much from you for example there is too much to remember for the exams and I am definitely not a Math person but he does reply to emails very fast and gives curves on the exams. There is good and bad. The exams are a big part of your grade and there are 3 proctored exams.

Not your typical prof who just says to memorize the formulas bc that's how it is. I DO NOT RECOMMEND! Especially if youre taking it online. I have been an A student all my life, and this is the first class to trouble me. You have to teach yourself. He does not provide lecture videos or any help. Responds to emails late and with little information.

Outstanding professor. Because of him, I understand and actually like calculus. Explanations went deep and made me get what the point of all the equations were. You need to let him know when you need help and be proactive about your learning. He has set aside hours a day several times a week to go over anything I was confused about. This class is known by all CS majors everywhere to be notoriously difficult. I was so scared coming into the class, I prepped by watching videos on YouTube. If you are wanting to do it online; don't. I am a straight-A student who is very talented in math and his class is the hardest I've ever taken. This prof goes out of his way to help you learn. But you have to try. Professor seems very smart and good at what he does. Was offered the chance to do a zoom meeting if I needed extra help, but I actually didn't get a reply back until about a week and a half later so there went that chapter exam... good guy but don't recommend online class with him.

Not really a good teacher to chose if you are NOT very good in math. He talks very fast and expects you to already know the work. Test were easy, all multiple choice. online summer, will pass but not bc of him If you email him do not expect a reply unless its in 5-7buisness days by then the homework is already dueother students all agreed that he is doing the bare minimum emailed him about it to quote him teachers have more important things than email their students if you're a online teacher thats how youteach

This class was easyish bc I watched the videos for each lesson in mylab and used the "help me solve this" feature on the homework and i did all my assignments, but i called his office 2 different times this semester and he never got back to me. midterm&final werent the same as the practice tests, but on the same concepts so i was slightly prepared.

Perfect professor if you really want/need to understand material. He is very thorough. -Sometimes spent too much of class going over the homework and too little time teaching material - 2 tests and a final. The final is HARD. Professor Nghiem, V is an excellent teacher. He explains the material clearly; He is there for you when you need help; He helps students to reach their highest potential; He encourages you all the time... I already took two of his classes, and I will definitely have his statistic.

Monica is awesome and you can tell she absolutely loves what she does. She really likes participation. Her lectures are usually fun and she gives prizes for some of the games. She's great, definitely recommend this class.

One of the best I have had. Always smiley and nice. Has tons of examples so even if you are not into psychological stuff you understand it. Quite easy assignments, values creativity even if you just make it up a night before it's due. Definitely recommending her and the class

The absolute worst teacher I have ever had at IU. Can't string together a sentence or stream of thoughts to save his life. Never comments on grades you receive back just slaps a grade on it. Rather take a much harder teacher than have a class with this moron.

No hw grades, only 3 exams. Reviews are exactly like exam, there are no surprises. Exam questions come straight from the hw, just slightly modified. Accent is understandable. Raluca seems very sweet but her lectures were sadly unengaging and her Romanian accent makes her hard to understand. She clearly has a passion for the material but somehow the way she explained concepts and delivered material was quite boring.

Professor herself was alright, not much to say as she was not too involved with the course (co taught with Peyrin). The course staff are what make this class so good though, and the textbook is one of the best.

I took his abnormal Psyc in the summer. I loved it
He's alright, his lectures can sometimes be interesting but a bore as well. Power points are essential to getting a good grade.  You study those thoroughly(!) and you'll do very well.

be sure to read the chapters in the book, pay attention to study guide and that helps in cutting down the information you need to know for the tests. Make sure to come to class, even though he doesnt take  attendance, it will be hard to navigate the class without coming to lecture

Weak stimulus control .. If you don't know what that means you will by the time the class is over. Has a tendency to talk way above your head. n.a

Before Popa every class I took at GSU left me completely uninterested... All the classes were slower than what I experienced in high school.   Popa's classes have been like a feast for a starving man.  By comparison he makes all my other professors seem like tired children . If you actually want to learn stuff in collage take his class.

Lectures were a bit disorganized, but very interesting.  He is very passionate about the material.  Not too many homework assignments, but they are worth a large part of the grade.  Easy exams. He wasn't a terrible teacher. He definitely tends to rant a lot but he's passionate about psychology. Amazing lectures. Attendance not required but class is FULL because they're INTERESTING. Loves Questions! 25% of the test is from his lectures. Make sure you UNDERSTAND  the book. Popa is a great professor and I enjoyed his lectures; however, he does get off track sometimes. This professor is not clear in his presentations nor in his slides. The slides are disorganized and rambly and his lectures are hard to understand because he is scatterbrained. I thought Mr. Popa was an excellent professor. You can tell he is passionate about his work and enjoys teaching. okay professor-yet hard to understand him due to lang. The subject: very interesting but his teaching style is very confusing. Great Teacher! She was one of my favorites this semester, very considerate and wise professor. Understanding and funny, she even provides snacks for hungry students that stay up too late working on work.

Definitely more more than I expected, but that's probably because Ms. Soto actually read my writing and really worked with me to help improve my writing skills. Very fascinating class! Learned a lot through the discussions and the papers. Manageable workload and great feedback about writing.

A true professional. She really cares about making her students better writers, and she does it without killing your grade. Your opinion matters in her class, so if you like to talk, you'll love the class.

She is SO incredibly kind. Incredibly understanding, openminded, and catering to her students.

Korfine is one of the nicest professors you will ever meet. Go to office hours and talk to her. But her lectures are too easy. She often just repeats what you read over the week and the class as a whole is too easy as well.

Definitely the kindest professor at Cornell. I didn't really like the class because of the subject matter, but the professor taught it well nonetheless. Very sweet, knowledgeable, and on top of things.

Professor Chambliss is stubborn when it comes to grading and refused to appreciate my effort when it came down to the wire. I recommend taking advantage of the low-hanging fruit in this class (there's a lot).

This class made me fall in love with writing! Through organized, informative lectures, Professor Chambliss made me a more effective critical thinker and analytical writer. It's always nice to learn from a professor who has a foot in the world instead of having stayed in academia all her life. Professor Chambliss is very passionate and knowledgable about what she teaches and always gives very constructive feedback to help you improve.

Professor Chambliss is really, really sweet, and cares that her students learn. She is always accessible outside of class, and I recommend meeting with her before writing assignments are due. He explains things very clearly, and cares very much. Amazing teacher.

Awesome class (comic theatre), super interesting subject and Rusten teaches it exceptionally, very enthusiastic about the subject and very conversational teaching style. GPA saving class but also just an enjoyable part of my week.

Boring class where memorization, not comprehension, is the only key to getting a good grade. The class was bloated with too many students.
