Dr. Soren and his service dog, Lana, are so precious and you don't know how sad I am to not see them every week! He is super nice and passionate about this course and every other course he teaches. Super easy class and very interesting! I totally recommend any class of Dr. Soren.

Not to exaggerate or anything but I would die for Dr. Soren and his sweet service dog Lana. This class is honestly super interesting if you're into art / art history, and Dr. Soren is the best professor I've ever had. He has lots of experience and is super passionate about the subject. I highly recommend any of his courses!!!

Dr. Soren is an AMAZING teacher. Not only is he hilarious, but very thoughtful and inspirational when it comes to teaching. If you are taking this course, I recommend you come to every lecture, if you do, there will be no problem with getting an A in this course!
he was amazing. really interesting classes, easy exams, and cool lectures. he also curves if you ask him to.

Anyone who rated Dr. Soren badly on this site probably received a poor final grade. All of the quizzes are self explanatory and easy if you pay attention in class. Dr. Soren was one of the best teachers I've had in college and I look forward to taking another class with him!

Soren is one of the few teachers now a days that really cares about the topic he is teaching. He is funny and generally caring for his students. The quizzes are easy, because the preceptors write up review powerpoints and the tests are cake, cause Soren goes over everything the class before the tests. Awesome teacher!!!

Dr. Soren is hilarious and makes lectures interesting. For everyone saying that the quizzes were hard, probably did not review the powerpoints or skipped class. He tells countless cheesy jokes, but he really knows what he's talking about.

Dr. Soren is amazing! He is one of the best professors I have ever had. Everything he talks about is very personal because he has lived through it all. He is very personable and very easy to talk to if you have questions. The class, on the other hand, is a little indifferent. You are graded on a total of 5 things and they are either tests or papers

possibly the worst class I have ever taken. the only things in the grade are quizzes, a midterm, and a final. the quizzes are open ended questions that you must provide 3 facts and dates about the question he asks which are usually over 3 very poorly written chapters in a textbook written by him. doesnt even define what a good fact is AT ALL

The worst class I have had. For passing a quiz, you must memorize 5 facts(including date) about each person he mentions in class. The quizzes are only short answers (and close note). For the midterm, you got an essay as a part of your midterm. You cannot see your note during writing this essay. The topics are something he briefly mentions in class.

The lecture design was made by a third grader. There was no structure to his lesson plans. His TAs never graded consistently. He gives you a list for 40 terms to memorize for a quiz and tests you on 2! He spent a month on the Mona Lisa and DID NOT include her on the exam or quizzes. His TAs did not feel the need to use a microphone in a 900.

Dr. Soren is a gem. He is the sweetest person and definitely one of my favorite professors. He makes the class interesting by watching films and his exams are easy as long as you attend his lectures and pay attention. His TA's do skits that are so horrendous that they are hilarious and it just makes the class that much better.

Dr. Soren is one of those professors who truly does give his students the tools they need to succeed in his course. He knows lectures can be dense, so he always has his TA's break it up with cheesy humor or magic tricks. He's also very flexible with final grades, and even though I had an 87%, he rounded it up to an A because he saw improvement!

Dr. Soren is a great lecturer and keeps the class interested by telling jokes and doing comical things. The quizzes and tests are not bad but memorization of dates is key. No homework, just a final essay. Some of the material gets dull at times but overall its a great and easy course to take.

Dr Soren is one of the best professors at UA, hands down. He is an engaging lecturer and makes the material easy to understand. Grade based on a midterm, a final, and three quizzes. Show up every day and get extra credit at the end of the semester. During the lecture on dance, he demonstrated the steps. At 70 years old. Surprisingly good dancer!

He is a great guy! Funny & just a cute man who is super passionate and famous. However, his class is not the best gen ed. You're only graded on two tests and three quizzes. For quizzes, you learn 40 terms to be tested on 2. If you aren't passionate about art cinema history, don't take! Too stressful & not meant for people exploring the topic.
Love Dr. Siren. Best Professor on the campus. Hands down. Entertaining and engaging lectures! Makes learning easy!

Professor Soren is so funny and keeps class entertaining.  The quizzes are easy as long as you take some time to study the vocab. This class doesn't require a lot of work, you just need to pay attention during lectures. Will definitely be taking more of his classes.

Oh what a fun class.  You probably won't learn too much from this class really but he keeps it fun and interesting. Only 4 quizzes and one gets dropped. A midterm and a final and a few readings. Do the readings and look at the slides before the test and it's a cakewalk. Attendance is mandatory though.

Dr. Soren is amazing. Lana the Dog usually attends class with you. Show up or you won't pass, read the textbook or you won't pass. There is five quizzes and one of them gets dropped, also a midterm and a final. Great class, just put some effort into it and you will pass

Dr. Soren is the absolute best professor at the UofA. His jokes, although incredibly cheesy, are great. He really is a wonderful professor that truly cares about his students and always makes time for them even while he is running to his millionth meeting with his dog. You won't regret taking his classes.

Dr. Soren is a cute old man who is very passionate about the material, and he brings his dog to every class!! Quizzes are kind of ridiculous because theres 100 terms to study from for only a two question quiz. Otherwise, the midterm and final are easy A's as long as you study. Don't really have to go to class but randomly takes attendance.

He gives excellent feedback. There is not a question he would not answer and there is nothing he would not do to help you succeed in any of his classes. All you have to do is ask for help. I was a science major but I took him for 3 classes to cover my upper division elective and I would do it all over again. He is the best professor I ever had.

Soren is the sweetest guy and he tries really hard to make the class fun by cracking jokes and getting his TAs involved but its all so endearing you won't mind the cheesiness. He gives "pop' quizzes but you'll always know when they are and it's not hard to guess what they'll be on. Study the night before each test, that's all you need to pass.

Dr. Soren is the most knowledgeable Professor on his subject matter that I have had at the U of A. He has appeared on the Discovery and History channels and is one of the top Archaeologists in the world. You will learn a ton in his classes and he makes it fun and I would take every class that he teaches if I could.

Straight forward class. If you attend and do the readings you probably won't have trouble. Dr. Soren interrupts his own lectures with little skits or jokes that help keep things entertaining, and you get to watch a few movies as well.

Dr. Soren is a really great guy and is super passionate but in all honesty his class is way to hard for a gened. You have to memorize approximately 25 dates for simple quizzes and his lectures are hard to listen to because the material is dry. I would 100% take a different Gen Ed. Too much work required for not that important of a class.

Dr Soren is the best! His jokes are hilarious, his lectures are great, and he can sing! There is a lot of info in the class but the preceptors and TA's are really helpful. There are only a handful of quizzes and a midterm and final. You need to memorize dates but other than that his tests are pretty easy. Take his class if you can!!!

I found out that his TA's are firmer graders because they like to be sticklers of essays. Overall, class was not difficult, many students slept. If you are not keen on roman/greek tragedy or art deco it may take a bit to get it. He tries to make class fun with cheesy jokes but so easy!

Okay, I'll be honest, the class is hard to stay up in. I fell asleep every day once the lecture started, but Prof. Soren is very kind & funny. As noted that I slept half the time, I still a 80%+ on all quizzes & tests. A little effort goes a long way. Just know & understand the terms. I don't know how you can do bad in this class.

There are about 4 exams including the midterm and final exam. Along with each exam get ready to write a short essay in response to one of the prompts provided and make sure to do all the readings and make sure to remember several paintings from lecture and the book because they will most likely be on the exams.
He is an easy going teacher and cares about students. You will laugh a lot in his class and as long as you do a little work the class is the easiest A you'll ever get.

Dr. Soren is an amazing professor. He is so passionate about the material he teaches. While, yes, their is a lot of material to learn for the two tests he basically tells you exactly what you need to know during his in-class reviews. The four quizzes are a little more complicated. You will have to memorize lots of dates; he is a stickler for dates.

I absolutely loved this class and Dr. Soren. He's smart, passionate, and adorable. But, do not take it if you are not interested in art history!  Go to class every day and take good notes. If you do this, you absolutely do not need $100+ worth of "required" textbooks. The in-class review is essential for the tests. Draft out your essay beforehand.

Dr. Soren is one of the most passionate and inspirational teachers I've had, and probably one of the most interesting. He really knows his stuff, but there's a lot of info in his lectures.  There's only 4 quizzes & 2 tests. For the tests, just study what he reviews in class (don't rely on the TA's review). I never bought the books and I did fine.

Dr. Soren has been my favorite professor. His lectures are interesting and he is so passionate. There are only a couple quizzes and a midterm which are easy as long as you take good notes, and study for a couple hours.

Professor Soren is a real sweet guy and is extremely smart. However I didn't find the context of his lectures interesting which made it difficult to pay attention. There aren't any assignments just a few test and quizzes but you HAVE to pay attention in class to pass them.

Yes he tells you a billion terms to memorize but honestly all you need to memorize are the ones he took the time to discuss in his lectures. I got an A in the class and I did not invest a lot of time in the class. Attend lectures. would just study sincerely a day or two before a test or quiz & I would be fine. Very passionate about what he teaches.

Dr. Soren is an amazing teacher! There are 4 quizzes (drops 1 lowest grade), the midterm, and Final. If you can memorize 150+ vocabs you should do fine,  I memorized all the terms the night before and still managed to get A's and B's. (pretty obvious which terms to study) & you don't need the book! I would take a another class with him again! :)

Dr. Soren was funny! Don't need the book at all, BUT you do need to study! Average of 50 terms for quizzes of which he only chooses 2. Listen to lectures, and you'll pretty much know which two terms he'll pick from!

You don't need the textbooks, the Best class ever, he is funny. Just study the review slides provided by the preceptors and you will be fine. I had no interest in history but he made this class interesting. Didn't study for the midterm and did not do well, studied for the final and got a 90. Basically all you have to do is study, good luck :)

This was somehow one of the easiest and most informative classes that I've ever taken. Yes, there are a lot of terms to memorize, but the terms that end up on the quizzes and tests are things that are emphasized in lecture or they are things that you probably know about already. Don't buy the textbooks for this class! You can find everything online

Do NOT take this class if you are looking for an easy A or are not interested in classical history. Soren seems like a great guy, and he's funny. However, I am a 4.0 student, but I will not be anymore after this class. I'm a pre-physio major and I struggle succeeding in this course. Tests are hard and there is a lot of reading. Not easy to get by.

Professor Soren is passionate and an AMAZING teacher.. I love the guy!!!! His study guides are great and makes sure you retain the knowledge and have fun.. He is not out to stump you on exams and provides great study material. He is a funny dude!!

Memorizing 100+ terms at once was so freaking hard.  Barely made it out with a good grade in this class.  I went to him for help and he wasn't very helpful at all.  Would not recommend if you want an easy "A" gen ed.

I always love Dr. Soren's lectures and his knowledge and personal experience on the subject matter is simply unmatched. Attendance is critical for understanding the subject matter and the review sessions hosted by the T/A's will help alot.

I can't say enough good things about Dr. Soren and I loved this class! He is extremely interested in his work and presents the material well. There are four quizzes and two exams. Pay attention in class and you'll ace them all. For attendance he puts random names up on the board each class to check. Take this class!
Do NOT take this class if you have a choice. The memorization of 50+ terms+ birth and death year of every artist- not worth it!!!!!!!!

Do not take this course as a Gen Ed. Only suffer through this class if it is required for your major. The Quizzes are worth 1/3 of your final grade, and are only 2 vocabulary terms out of a list of roughly 50 that is given.
Best class i have ever taken in my life! Explains things clearly and with his energetic personality, he makes the class interesting!

If you are looking for a gen-ed that doesn't require a lot of work or studying, this is not the class for you. The material is beyond dry. The tests and quizzes are easy if you don't mind studying 75+ words & facts per quiz. He takes random attendance of 20 people in the course, per class. The best part of the course was that he brought his dog in.

Another user said to go to all the review sessions, but they are ran by the preceptors that are also taking the class with you. They always have wrong information on the slides and the TA's, who have already taken the class, just sit there and correct them. The whole class is unorganized and a pain to be in. AVOID.
Thought this would be harder. Definitely too many words to memorize. But it peaked my interest in ancient Roman and Greek history. Worth taking the class with Soren. Go to all the reviews

I loved Dr. Soren as a person. He is such a cute, nice guy and truly loves teaching. The class is boring but he tries his best to make it interesting. There is an INCREDIBLE amount of memorizing. Quizzes are 40-50 terms, you have to know a range of dates, a def, and 3 facts for every word, and only 2 terms are on the quiz. Wouldn't recommend.

He gets behind on material but still quizzes you on things that you haven't talked about in class because "it's part of the readings". Quizzes aren't difficult, but midterm and final can be tricky. It's all memorization, so be prepared to cram all the info for a short amount of time.

Super easy class! Class attendance helps boost your grade at the end. 3 quizzes, a midterm, and a final which is stressful but he only counts 3/4 quizzes, so you get a freebie. Just go to the reviews by the TAs, they give you the terms for the quizzes and you only need to know the popular ones. I would highly recommend!

His classes are all strictly memorization. Your only grades are 3 quizzes, the midterm, and the final. You have to remember dates for everything, 3 facts for everything, etc. For a Gen Ed course, the memorization requirement is extremely ridiculous. The professor is very likeable, but doesn't have realistic expectations by any means.

Although Dr. Soren is a "cute" old man, he expects way too much from his students taking this course as a gen. ed. The memorization skills required are extreme. I would not recommend this course unless you are already a film history fanatic.

He is a great guy and his lectures CAN be entertaining, if you are a good cram studier/memorizer you will do well in this class, attendance is "mandatory" but even if you don't go to class you can easily get a A or B. The tests seem like a ton of material as do the quizzes but 3 or so hours of cramming will get the job done.

He is such a cool guy. He tries to make the class interesting and tells you exactly what is on the quizzes and tests, usually the most emphasized things in class. Going to class helps a lot and so do the review sessions. If you're good at memorization it isn't too hard but be prepared to put some effort in and make flashcards

Not a chill gen ed. Took this course hoping for an easy A, which it isn't. His quizzes are 11 percent each and he chooses his 2 terms from a list of 40. u must known the birth and the death date, full definition and 3 facts in sentence form. NOT AN EASY GEN ED!

This class is primarily based off memorization. You do not have to go to class because all you need to know is terms for the test and quizzes. If you're good at memorizing then this class is cake. The help sessions prior to a test go over everything you need to know.

Do not take this class.  The class is solely based on three quizzes, a midterm, and a final.  The quizzes are a joke, they ask you to give a good definition, date, and three facts for 50+ terms.  The TA's grade your quizzes, and midterm so strictly.  This class is difficult, and if you put in the time you still won't succeed.  Stay away from this

Class is extremely difficult with memorization. There are a huge amount of terms and you need a definition, date, and 3 facts for each. The TAs decide if your facts are 'good' enough, and you can get 0 points on something you understood 100%. I would not recommend to anyone because grades are unfair and weighted too highly on small quizzes.

Pretty, pretty, pretty, pretty good. Quizzes are based off the two most obvious terms and the reviews go over exactly what's on the midterm/final. Guy's always crackin' wise making class all sorts of fun.

I did not know much of anything taught in this class prior to taking it but I would say this class is relatively easy. You have to work a bit but he tells you exactly what is on the quizzes and exams and you really don't need the books. Curves your grade a little at the end if it is near the next letter grade. I would say take it!

This class isn't "a joke" but it is easy if you go to class and pay attention. Dr Soren tells you EXACTLY what you need to know for tests and quizzes. He takes some attendance at every class and going to class guarantees you don't have to study much before exams. He's a very smart, funny and nice guy and going to class is a joy.

The easiest class one could take at the UofA. I did not attend one full lecture and received an A on every quiz and a 98% on the midterm. Have yet to take the final but I am not worried at all. Take this if you want an easy A.
easy

GREAT TEACHER! if you put in the effort you will learn SOOO much! you just need to go to class. warning: he blocks wifi in the classroom so if you need to troll fb while youre in class, you'll probly hate it

Soren is my favorite professor I've had so far, great sense of humor and obvious passion about the subject.This class is straight memorization, that's it. If you are not good at memorization, do not take this class. That's the only  reason he has low ratings is for the kids who can't memorize. 3 quizzes 2 exams, easy A/B if you can memorize/cram.

The best teacher I've ever had in my entire life!! I've taken 340b and 329 with him and it's honestly a very easy A if you go to class, pay attention/good at memorization (If you don't go to class, make sure you read the books). I would recommend taking any of his classes.
The most profound professor one could ever meet.

I have taken CLAS 300, 340B, and 329. Easy classes. I never went to lecture, got an A. He says he takes attendance and counts it against you but he doesnt in the end. I have never had any points taken off my final for lack of attendance. In each of the courses, there are 3 quizzes and 2 exams. If you're good at memorization, you're golden.

loved this proff.   he's such a cute old man and the life he has lived is amazing. His lectures can be boring at times, but some things he teaches are REALLY interesting. I'd recommend anyone take his class

He's great. If you take one semester for a requirement, take it with him again. 300 and 329 are really similar easy A. This man has had a really interesting life and loves sharing it with his students :)
great class and professor! does random attendance. quizzes are tough because of the amount of vocab words.

Dr. Soren is one of the best professors I have ever had at the U of A. I took his CLAS 329 class and thought it was awesome but ANTH 340b was pretty cool too. I think this class was a bit harder than CLAS 329 because you have to memorize most of the emperors and buildings of ancient Rome. Just attend every class and take good notes and you're set!

Not a REALLY difficult class, but does require effort. I didnt have an interest for art history nor films but needed this credit and it ended up being one of my favorite classes. Dr. Soren is intelligent and passionate and this class was very interesting.

Dr. Soren is probably one of the most interesting and compassionate people I have ever met. A quick Internet search will reveal his credentials, which range from archeological excavations to producing films like MADAGASCAR. Beyond this, Dr. Soren is passionate about his subject and imparts his own experiences into the lectures. Take this class!

This class is easy in the sense that I don't do anything for it (attend or do the readings) until a few days before the exams and quizzes. They are brutal & there is a ton of memorization & for those few days this class consumes a lot of my time. But I figure it is worth it. Don't bother with the books if you plan to go to the review sessions.

329 is not so bad itself, but the quizzes and tests are ridiculous. Always have to go because you are never sure if your name will be up, and there is so much more to know than what he covers in class. The memorization is awful, and it really isn't that interesting. If your looking for an A, only take this class if you can memorize 50+ terms easy.
THIS CLASS IS HARD.  The professor is very nice and interesting, but his quizzes/tests require a ridiculous amount of memorization.  Attendance is mandatory too.

Dr. Soren is a sweet old man who knows his stuff but the amount of memorization required for the class is beyond ridiculous. There are 3 quizzes for the semester, and for each you must know 50+ terms including 1 def, birth & death date, & 3 facts! Then he only tests you on 2 of the 50+ terms! Its ridiculous! And the midterm isn't any easier.

Soren is the man. The lectures are good enough to where if you wanna pay attention its educational but if you don't its pure memorization for the whole class. Its a sure A if you pay attention and can memorize but if you don't pay attention, go to the reviews, and memorize, its still an A.

Dr. Soren amazing - one of the best professors I've had. He is extremely knowledgable and passionate about the material. Corny jokes, but he always made me smile. Yes, there is A LOT of memorizing (60 terms + date, definition & 3 facts) but he always picked ones he focused on in class. I was never interested in art, but this was my favorite class.

Very funny and cute professor, but soooo much memorization involved. We have to know 60 terms and from those terms we have to know the dates and 3 facts but the thing is he only test us on 2. take this class if your good at memorization!
Amazing professor, knows his stuff.

I really enjoyed this class. Dr. Soren is passionate about what he's teaching, committed to helping all of his students succeed, and overall, a great man. He's funny, and organized an clear when lecturing. I highly recommend taking any course he teaches.

Ended up with a high A but I wouldn't take another class like this. I have no interest in classics which might be the reason why I didn't enjoy it. Or it could be the mind-numbing memorization. Class requires no thought, only memorizing terms/dates/facts. It's really not hard, just annoyingly intensive on memorization.

Dr. Soren is a great professor, he makes sure to take time to help you connect with experts in your field of study in anthropology. He also brings his dog to class which is cute. The class is mostly an easy "A" and the textbook isn't really required. There are 3 short answer quizzes, a midterm and a final and no homework, its definitely manageable.

Class is super boring, but Soren is a cute old man and tries to joke around to keep you entertained. Attendance is mandatory but is only counted in about Involves lots of memorization about things that have nothing in common--- hitler, lesbian directors, doors. Not too hard of a class, but boring and lots of work for minimal points.

Dr. Soren is the nicest professor I've ever had. He inserts a lot of little jokes into his lectures to make them more interesting. There is a ton of memorization involved but that's pretty much the extent of the quizzes and exams. Good class to take.

Dr. Soren is PASSIONATE about what he's teaching. Although the class may seem dull at times, pay attention for the little jokes/humor he sneaks in. He'll present new pieces of info to topics we've learned many times, which makes it more relevant. This class involves a lot of memorization, but there's no busy work. If you're self-motivated it's fun

Dr. Soren is a nice teacher. He tries to make class interesting but the topic he's talking about isn't the best. There are no homework assignments, there's three quizzes,  a midterm and final and that's it. This class is pure memorization so if you don't like studying that way then you will not like this class. I personally found it to be very easy

This class requires a LOT of memorization, Soren is such a nice guy who makes this class interesting and it's pretty easy to predict what will be on the quizzes. You won't need the textbooks if you go to the review sessions.
He is a sweet guy with an amazing singing voice. Onae a midterm + a final + 3 quizzes. Each quiz required to know 40+ terms with facts, dates. But once you know it the quizzes are okay.

Soren is the man! He's older but brings so much energy to the class and makes it a fun atmosphere. He has passion for his subject. The TAs are kinda lame, but there is one midterm, one final, and 3 quizes which makes up your grade for the class. 1-2 hours before each and you'll ace it. Definitely worth the trade off if you want an A and a fun dude.

not too hard, this class give new meaning to the word "cramming". memorizing 50-90 terms in one night is basically the only way to get a good grade. He give you the terms early but the preceptors give you the def, date, and 3 facts the night before the quiz/test and you obviously want to use those. If you are not good at memorization dont take it!
loved this class!
Best teacher at the UofA hands down. He is hilarious, genuine, and so passionate about what he teaches. If you have the opportunity you MUST take one of his classes!!

Great class! makes class fun and keeps you entertained. Attendance not mandatory but attending will definitely help your grade. Awesome teacher, really loves what he does. Makes me wish I had majored in history

take this class if you are super genius something like that or hella good at memorizing over tons of terms for only tests and quiz. Or, I RECOMMEND YOU NOT TO TAKE THIS CLASS. this class will drive you nuts and ruin ur gpa....

He's an ok guy but his TAs are mean/sarcastic/terrible. He is super paranoid about cheating and the entire class of 1500 people has to suffer for his delusions. With 1500 people you are totally lost in the crowd, but have mandatory attendance. The class is WAY too hard for a Gen-ed! He and his TAs do not know your name and do not care if you fail!

Honestly, this class was pretty easy. There's a lot of information and although some of it might seem useless, just study, attend lectures, PAY ATTENTION, and memorize little details and you're good. Using textbook isn't really needed. If you attend lectures and pay attention, you'll be fine. Going to the reviews the preceptors hold is helpful too!

he is my absolute favorite professor. Always funny and full of knowledge. Also, he's the most interesting professor i've ever had. definitely a fun class as long as you attend and study for tests/quizzes its an easy a.

Extremely easy class, and Prof. Soren does a decent job trying to teach and entertain students. You have to sit through corny jokes (uses the same ones every semester) but the quizzes and tests are pretty easy, and attendance isn't mandatory. It's not great being in such a large class, but it fulfills the requirements.

Dr. Soren makes going to class at 9am 3 days a week very bearable. He shows funny video clips during lectures and makes them interesting. I learned a lot from his class. He does random attendance so even if the class is large you still could get called any day. Quizzes are easy if you study! Same for exams. Just study dates well and you're good!

I found this class to be extremely EASY. If you think memorizing 20 to 30 facts for a couple quizzes and tests is hard, then maybe college isn?t for you. I only spent a couple nights the entire semester studying ? that was the amount of work I had to do. Soren is very funny and entertaining. Take this class and don?t buy the book, you won?t use it.

Awesome class and awesome professor. The class is interesting if you like learning fun interesting facts about the history of cinema, tests and quizes are EASY. The preceptors for this class make a powerpoint with all the answers that you just have to memorize. I did almost none of the readings and got an A.

Oh Dr. Soren... what a guy. Lectures are amazing, this guy truly has lived life to the fullest. Easy class, until it's quiz/exam time. Be prepared to study, HARD! They are exceptionally difficult, but thankfully it's the only work you actually have to do for the class. I'd definitely recommend this class, just dont expect an easy ride all the way.

Dr Soren is an awesome guy, but this class was the worst.  Its based on pure memorization. You have to memorize hundreds of names, exact dates, and facts, but then he only will test you on a few (and he wont tell you which ones prior) and most of the stuff he talks about will never show up on quizzes or exams. Worst class I've taken!

The class was pretty interesting, but he does make you remember a lot of information for quizzes and then he only tests you on 2 terms. I just went to class for attendance and came in to class for quizzes and tests and I still managed to get an A.

If you love Roman art, this is the class for you. Dr. Soren knows this stuff--he should, he's been doing it for over 40 years! He's funny and entertaining and you will learn tons! Quizzes and tests do include dates, but what history class doesn't? If you go to class you shouldn't have too much of a problem. Definitely take a class with Soren!

Dr. Soren is simply the best professor you could take at the U of A. His classes are fascinating, he tries very hard to keep the class engaged, shows great movies & clips, talks to students before class, etc. Tests and quizzes do involve dates but I never spent more than an hour studying. Go to class and you'll be golden. Take him, you'll love it!

Professor Sana is a gem. There are few classes I would take an 8am for, but this is definitely one. His lectures and the content were super interesting, and the assignments were not too bad. He's a cool guy. He talks for most of the class period & there's alot of reading for his class. But all of it's neccessary because they all appear on the exam in some way. Easy readings, easy assessments, easy assignments. Material was somewhat interesting but not as much as I thought it'd be--maybe because at 8am barely anyone can really engage. Not worth it if you are not a morning person since attendance is mandatory.

Professor Sana is a little hard to get used to at first because he is quite particular about his expectations for course work, getting in touch with him and classroom activities. This class is very interesting, especially if you're interested in immigration. He assigns a lot to read and has random, easy quizzes over them. Good choice for an INT class. The material was very interesting and the readings were light. Lectures were solid as well, but just make sure to take notes for the exams. Homework and writing assignments weren't graded too harshly and it's not too hard to get an A.

Super easy and interesting class if you're interested in immigration. Gives lots of reading on hw and has pop quizzes on them, but really easy, you can just skim them and get a 100. Easy grader, eccentric but very nice guy.
Lots of readings. The exams are relatively easy to do well on. Just keep up with the readings and you should do fine.
Professor Sana is a great lecturer and you can tell he is passionate about the subject matter. Although there are readings, if you keep up with the classwork you will do well.

Fun guy, fair grader. Easy A as long as you do the work. Long readings weekly but they're interesting and he really pulls out the key info in his lectures.

Pretty good choice for an International class. Readings and classes were pretty interesting. Exams weren't too challenging and pop quizzes over the readings were straightforward. Professor Sana is by far one of my favorite professors at Vanderbilt. Great personality and his lectures are interesting and informative. SOC 3321 with Professor Sana is one of the best classes I've taken. The class is lecture heavy, but he incorporates group discussions. Professor Sana is a caring teacher and his class was very interesting. There are three books you read from but truly his lectures are more important and there really is no information on slides. -reading for every class (there are pop quizzes) but a lot of the articles are really interesting -his lectures are a little all over the place, but if you type everything up and study it for the exams, then you will be golden. the content is interesting. -3 discussion posts (try and u will do well) -4 hws (3 easy As, 1 easy A w some effort)

Professor Sana really knows his stuff when it comes to statistics. He tries to make a boring subject as digestible as possible while expressing genuine interest that his students understand the material.

Dr. Sana's class is my favorite class this semester. If you can't handle taking an 8am class, then don't take this. If you can handle it, I highly recommend it. Seems a little strict at the beginning of the semester but is actually really nice and passionate about what he teaches. There are a lot of readings that you have to do because of pop quizzes but they're all very interesting and the quizzes are straight forward.
Worst lecturer
the best prof at VU

Professor Sana was a great lecturer and the material was engaging enough to keep me awake during an 8am class. Easy A's on all assignments, tests aren't too challenging, make up 40% of grade.

This class was awful. Required for sociology majors, but seriously, wait to take it with someone else. He teaches straight from the book and is super boring. Fromme is a fantastic person and professor. He genuinely cares about the course and students and is clearly very passionate about the subject matter. Do at least some of the readings and study and you will do well in this course.

He goes over everything in great detail and all the tests are based on the lectures in class. There are three tests and he drops the lowest one. There are also two essays. Take him!!

Professor Farner is great! Hell drop your lowest test score at the end of the semester & his tests are around 13-15 questions but only 10 are required so there is an opportunity for extra credit on every test. His readings are required but his description of them the next day in class is enough to past.

Polite and funny professor! Readings not really required, he goes over them in class (I only read whatever reading was assigned to the essay I chose). Shows several sci-fi movies, tests reference them A LOT so don't miss. 3 tests, drops lowest score - not including final. Has 13-15 questions only required to answer 10, answer rest for extra credit

A great dude. Funny, polite, and very well informed. We got to watch a bunch of science fiction movies and shows and analyze them. Nothing was overtly difficult. His lectures are informative, and he allows for students to ask questions and give feedback (something a lot of professors ought to do more). Overall a very nice person.

Dr. Farner is funny and kind. But more importantly there is no BS in his class. What he teaches is exactly what will be on the test, no trick questions, no random theory or topic not covered. I wouldnt say he is easy, but because he is such a good professor it almost seems easy.

3 written exams (drops the lowest). 1 final written exam (same as other ones, but worth more points). 2 writing assignments (one is 2-3 pgs & other is a 6-8 research paper). Most readings are online, but there is a book where you read some chapters from it. Class & readings can be boring, but interesting as well. Takes roll so be there. Take notes!

Funny and interesting. I was fascinated by what I learned in this class. He is a university level professor, so you will learn a lot. He really helped me with my writing style.  3 short-answer essay--lowest dropped. Two papers and a short-answer essay final.  I would recommend him.

LBS 3860  Easy going professor highly recommend .The material may get boring at times but if you copy EXACTLY everything on the board you should do well on test . 3 written tests with 2 extra credit questions and the lowest score of the three test is dropped. Final has the same format as other tests. Assigned reading but not necessary.

I took professor Farner for my philosophy of film class and I really enjoyed it, he provided us with all the reading materials and gave great lectures. He provided study guides for test and is accessible outside of class. The films we viewed in class also pretty cool. Great professor overall, would take him again.

Farner is a great professor. His class is really interesting, and you learn more about science fiction.  No textbook is required, and all you do is come to lecture and watch sci-fi films. There are 3 writing assignments, but not too difficult.  Also, one midterm, final, and no quizzes.
Clear, straight forward.  You know exactly what to study for the exams.  No tricks.  It will be your fault if you don't pass this class.

Dirk is awesome! Our topic was animal studies and he was able to make the class super interesting. He is understanding, just don't take advantage. It can be super easy to get a good grade in this class so take notes and attend every class because you will literally have all the answers for his tests and midterm.

He was a great Professor I enjoyed his class and the topic was pretty interesting. 3 tests, best 2 count in final grade. Midterm & Final Essay and Final exam. Everything he writes on the board will be on the test, study notes and pass all his exams. Straight forward :)

Prof. Farner was Farner was great and has not been represented well in the comments. His lectures are great and to the point. Make sure to copy down everything on the board, it will help you pass the tests. You don't really have to read the articles because he goes over them in class. Just attend class, copy notes and study and you should do well.

Lectures the whole class period on the material you read, so its good to read the assigned stuff beforehand. 3 tests, 1 final (not cumulative) and 2 term papers. He's a tough grader but a really passionate about the subject. He's very kind too and will help if you ask!

Prepare yourself if you decide to take any of his classes. He does not post notes online, so unfortunately you have to try to read his cursive on a chalk board if you want notes to study with. He grades papers hard. And oh, if you have your phone out or disturb the class he WILL say something to you and embariss you in front of the class.

Go to the lectures he covers everything thats going to be on the tests and he plays movies but won't tell you when he's going to show them. Lectures are boring and pretty long and he won't let you out early but if you at least get notes from someone you'll pass. three tests, midterm paper, final paper, and final. The papers are easy tests are tough

4 written test. He drops your lowest one. I personally didn't read any of the assign articles. I just took notes word for word which kinda of help. Study! papers are okay. Movies are shown which okay. Some will catch your attention more while the other movies will make you fall asleep.

Come to class and take notes and you will pass. Farner is really an awesome professor, the topics he discusses are extremely interesting and that reviewer that said he makes you sexist must have been in the wrong class. This class is all about patriarchal power structures used for oppression and science's role in that. So enlightening.

Farner has by far been the worst professor i have ever had. I don't mean in the sense that he is difficult i mean in the sense that i have literally become more sexist the longer i was in his class. If you want to get an easy A while also becoming a less functioning part of society take this class.

His class is exciting but boring at times. Just be ready to jot down everything on the board because it is super helpful when it's time to take the test. Also,  essays are pretty straightforward and don't hesitate to take his class :)

Some of the readings can get tedious. However, he is very clear in his explanations and his teaching approach is sound. His tests are straightforward and his grading reasonable. You will have to earn the grade you receive and you will have to know your material but he is always there to help.

Attend everyday. His lectures are very clear and concise. Take very good notes as these notes will be on the exam. 3 exams are given each with 13 questions. 2 of the 3 exams are graded and 10 out of the 13 questions are graded. There are a lot of readings but he provides you with everything you need. Paper topics are okay and grading wasn't bad

He has a funny sense of humor. He can sound very monotone. He lays the information out clearly. Everything said in class is always on the tests. He has a clear agenda as to where he wants to guide the discussion. When we're wrong, instead of giving us the answer right away, he would ask us to inquire within our own answer. I really enjoyed him.

Let's put it this way I am an A student and got a C in this class. I would avoid taking this class in general unless it's needed. There is a lot of reading required. You spend the whole class time (with one 10 min break) taking notes which are all open for test questions. Tests and quizzes must be extremely detailed to a T or you will lose points.

Good professor!  I agree, he's on auto pilot. Lectures and movies are interesting.  Tests are straight from lectures so take good notes and be sure to attend class.  There are 2 papers.  Doing the reading, watching  films, and taking good notes will help with the papers.   Nice guy!

He has three tests, which he drops one. Then there's a final, a term paper, and a midterm paper. Easy if you study. He also gives study guides which are very useful. You need to go to class every day because there's a lot of notes, and movies.

Take this class. Easy A and makes lectures interesting. He says to read but you don't have to read at all. He goes over it the next class so don't buy book. Everything he writes on the board is what he puts on tests. tests are all short answer but very easy just go over notes. 2 essays which are easy and 4 tests and he drops the lowest test score.

Good guy, but you will be disappointed if you thought there would be a conversation about the topic. He will cover 2 or 3 pages of a 30 page article he asked you to read. This can be frustrating. I actually scored higher on an exam where I parroted everything he said rather than answer based on the reading. Kind and helpful but on auto-pilot.

Super easy professor, do not need to read any of the assignments because he summarizes everything you need to know in class. Make sure to write down all the notes on the bored, what is on the bored is on the test. Super easy class, straight to the point.

He gives out the answers to the reading, key points. Never had to read for the class. But for the essay, it'll help you out a ton. I got a B in the class. For the final you have to read. I passed all the midterms and did well on the essays. Easy teacher. I recommend you read for the final. it'll help a bunch.

Always takes role. Study well & know examples for the tests (30 min. each & 2/3 tests count). Ask questions if confused b/c he will answer promptly. Friendly & helpful professor. Seek help/guidance/critique for midterm take home essay & term paper to get a better grade (even if you think you're a good writer). Book available on reserve. Recommend!

Class is Easy. Just take down all notes and study off those. 3 'quizzes' and the lowest grade gets dropped. midterm is take home paper (3 pages) Term paper is 6 - 8 pages. Final is the EXACT format as 'quizzes' EXCEPT worth more points. occasional videos which are interesting. He's a great professor. Highly Recommended!

Came in thinking I was going to struggle, came out with an A!  He is so organized and has a great lesson plan.  Lectures and notes are so clear. The notes are the test! No book really necessary. Two papers (mid-term & final) super easy. Very interesting class! 100% recommend Dr. Farner!

very helpful and interesting, class is easy just make sure to study with the study guides he provides and write everything down. does not post lectures online so it's important you attend class. midterm is a paper 4 quizzes the lowest gets dropped term paper is 6 six pages and the final is the same format as the quizzes.
Dr. Farner is an excellent lecturer. His class wasn't very difficult either. Highly recommended.

he's pretty easy just write down everything he writes down and study them youll do fine, i recommend you don't buy the book until needed mostly of them are online reading so if you want to save money wait till he signs book reading 2 paper, a final, 4 quizzes but one gets dropped mostly lecture based, few movies, speaks softly overall pretty easy

He checks attendance every time so you have to show up. He likes to use every bit of class time so don't expect to get out early. He seems to grade the quizzes quite critically, but he drops the lowest one out of the 3. He also has 2 papers and a final. Readings are online and you occasionally watch a movie for 30 mins.

Write down everything he writes on the board and you will be fine. His writing is not very good so sit close enough where you can make out the words. Good teacher and willing to help. 3-4 page take home midterm paper. 6-8 page term paper. 4 quizzes (lowest dropped) and final.
Very nice professor, it was a very interesting course. No textbook, all the readigs are online. Do the readings and you will do fine.
Great professor! Very interesting class, and I defintely learned a lot.

Dr. Farner is a good professor. Has German accent, but it's easy to understand. Quizzes are short answer, but you need to memorize A LOT of stuff.  Studied my a$$ off but got an A-.  Great choice for your theme class.
Easy guy. You don't really have to show up all the time, but go at least 80 percent of the time. You can pass the test and quizzes without notes as long as you listen attentively during the lectures.

Easy class but pretty boring. Attendance is mandatory because you have to take notes which he writes on the board and are on the test. He gives a study for every test and all answers are on the notes so you cannot fail unless you don't study at least the day before. Final paper is confusing and he  is not helpful whatsoever.

Pretty easy professor. Gives study guide for every test and drops lowest grades. You only have to answer 10 of 15 questions. Midterm is a 3 page paper. Final is a 6 page paper. He is not very helpful when it comes to the paper. Lectures are not that fun. He uses every minute of class time so don't expect to get out early, ever.

He is super easy. Just go to class and pay attention to some of the stuff he lectures on the write papers. Tests are worry-free since he gives out study guides and even drops the lowest test score. Imo, there is no need for the book unless the topic you choose to write on is related to the articles in the book. Overall, nice class.

good prof. his subject is a little dry, just lectures during class meeting, and sometimes tries to have class particpate but mostly lectures. Administers 4 examines but drops lowest one at the end; examines only 30 minuete long for writing 15/20 short answers (not enough time) overall good prof. should take

I thought this would be a boring class.Prof.Farner makes it interesting. Everything is on reserve at the library, just be sure to copy the notes he puts on the board and you will do well on the tests. 3 tests(drops lowest grade)-3 page midterm paper, 5 page final+test. don't let this scare you. The essays are based on subjects we went over in class

He was clear in his expectations of the class. Quizzes were short answer and only required you to answer 10 from the entire test, so you could partially answer all questions for full credit.  Supplemented lectures with interesting films. Wrote all the notes you needed on the board and handed out study guides. Very approachable.

I had Farner for Gender in Science and he's a great teacher.  The class consisted of 3 quizzes, a 3 pg midterm paper, a 6-8 pg term paper, and a final.  The quiz and final are super easy as he goes through everything in the notes; it's nearly impossible to fail unless you don't show up for class.  He's nice, patient, and has a cool German accent!

Farner is a great guy. Smart, Interesting, and can be sarcastic when he wants to be. Can be dry at times, like any Philos. Prof. Show up for class, he grades on atendence. Always willing to explain, even by email. Respects the students. And the German accent doesn't hurt. Ah... tests arn't bad at all. He made the class worth while.

Lectures can be kind of long but always made the readings assigned clearer after. Only 3 essays and he clearly defines what he wants in them. Tries to make every student think and give opinions about subjects and even makes it fun with interesting examples. Attend class and take notes and you will get an easy A.

his accent is awesome...hes german, kinda sounds funny at first but he knows what he is talking about. laid back, passive teacher that made class enjoyable by keeping the class interesting and thought provoking. 3 tests, 2 papers, and a final. extra credit is available on every test. textbook was cool...class was overall way better than i thought.

Farner is cool and very helpful. The class can become really tedious however and although attendance is not mandatory I suggest you SHOW UP. He gives out detailed notes that make it unnecessary to read the material. It is an easy class (for me at least I got an "A") but if you want to learn anything that is totally up to you.
He was very understanding and a good teacher.
Dr. Farner is very interesting.  He makes the class a lot of fun, if you try even a little bit.  He is very respectful to all students.
No Comments

Boring class.  I fell asleep almost everyday.  If you just copy down the notes everyday you will be fine.  Majority of the grade is on the final which is 2 short essays and two 3-5 page papers. Attendance is mandatory.  As bad as it sounds, he does not grade too hard. I gave half effort I still passed with a B-  Just use quotes and you will be fine.

boooring class. daydreamnt about getting hit by a bus...not easy/not hard class. got a B+. 2 papers 3-4 pgs, in class short answer final. learned alot in class. buy the book to quote material in your papers. takes attendance every single day. deducts pts for every absence.
Professor Rowley was my favorite professor at Taylor. Very helpful and went out of his way to help students learn the craft. Definitely recommend taking this class.

Super easy class. We had 2 short reaction papers, midterm and final. Tests were mostly multiple choice and about 10 questions total. Don't need to do the readings and fine to skip lectures/ not take notes. Lectures are a little dry/ not much is added beyond what's on the slides. Final exam took me 22 minutes and I got a 100 on it. Would recommend
good luck
He is all over the place in the best way possible. Loved hearing about his dogs.

Truly one of the best professors I've had at walsh and would take any of his classes whenever I have extra room in my schedule. His classes are lecture heavy by within the lectures he does help a ton when it comes to explaining what the philosophers are saying and help make connections between the books and films. Good person overall as well.

He's a really nice guy and is a great professor. Learned a ton from him and always offered helped when it was asked for. Helped with essays and making connections, as well as finding ways to make the philosophical text make more sense.

Dr. Vincenzo is not very good at teaching. He would go over the same subject multiple times over 3-4 classes and teach it the same way and expect a different result. Most of the information is common sense but can be tricky once you get to creating your own syllogisms. He makes his liberal political beliefs VERY well known.

I really did not enjoy his class whatsoever. I did learn a few things about venn diagrams and the rules. However, he spent most of his class time talking about politic, dog, and global warming. He would teach the same philosophical matter for over three classes. Overall, you do get an easy A on tests.

Said he made this course up and he obviously doesnt know what he is talking about. This class made me angry and I skipped a good amount of times because nothing was relevant. Very unorganized and taught the same thing for weeks. First test 60% of students BIG FAILED. But he let us retake it and we all passed. Cool dude but bad teacher.

Your entire grade relies on 3 papers that you write on the films shown in class. I took this as a night class and he always ran the full 3 hours. He often rambles on and on for the full time about stuff that doesn't really relate to a course. Course is an easy A but I wouldn't recommend it if you're looking for a class to enlighten you. Great guy!

Professor Vincenzo provided a lot of useful insight in basic principals of philosophy. I feel like I took away a lot of material that will help me in the future. Mostly a lecture based class, and a lot of content is covered in the semester.

Dr. Vincenzo is the man! A lot of great ideas dealing with philosophy and life in general. Interesting discussions that will leave you thinking a lot about the subject. Relaxed and very helpful when it comes to clarifying what he wants on the assignments. I would recommend him to anyone looking for a good Philosophy course or H2B requirement.
I loved this class! I learned a lot. Would take him again.

Dr. Vincenzo is a very intelligent man. Class made up of 4 papers, helps design papers during class lectures and discussion. Very interesting man to meet and be around. Class is very leisurely, understandable about missing class, has flexible due dates. If you need to take a Phil. class take him, very enlightening, unique view on life and leisure.

Dr. Vincenzo is a brilliant man. He knows so much, and is so passionate about the subject, sometimes his lectures go off course. That being said, if you have even the smallest desire to get a decent grade, or enjoy philosophy, this is a course to take. It requires little to no effort and Vincenzo will help anyway he can.

Dr. Vincenzo is so genuine, wise, and kind hearted!! He is willing to answer questions and help in any way possible. He is very passionate about philosophy and pushes students to critically think and connect philosophy points to movies. The class was interesting, fun, relaxing and relatively easy. I highly suggest taking this course.

Dr. Vincenzo is a great teacher.  He is very wise and experienced. Take his classes if you want to become a better, more well-rounded person.  He tends to repeat himself, but hidden behind the repetition are gems of pure wisdom.
great!

Very kind and genuine person who cares about his students. He WILL help in ANY way possible if you ask. Extremely knowledgeable. Yes, he does talk about his dog but his passion for animal training goes hand in hand with what he is teaching. Besides, it's nice to see someone who is beaming with a passion for something.

Philo Through Film was an easy class simply because you could skip class read the stuff outside the class and rent the movies to do the two comparative essays, which are the only things that accounts for your final grade.

Took Huma Nature with Dr. Vincenzo.  Although he is very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject, I can't say I learned a thing except things about him.  He talked about his dog a lot and told multiple stories about it each day. The class was extremely boring and he lectures the entire time.

BORING!! He told us at least 12 times a day to get Netflix. And then he'd talk about his dog for hours. The material was horrible to get through, at least the films were interesting. He does tell you exactly what to write so that's how I passed his class. Don't even bother taking him
great teacher
Great instructor, very passionate about the subject.  Enjoyed the class!

Enjoyed the class tremendously. Dr. Vincenzo was extremely patient with this class. Many classmates were expecting to be spoon fed the information and didn't like that he held them to higher standards. I enjoyed learning many new things and feel he did an excellent job.  Wish that I had to take more philosophy courses because of this class.

He took philosphy readings and then chose films that illustrated them. I liked his method of giving us hard readings to challenge us, as well as his desire to stimulate our ingenuity. We had essay tests which gave us the freedom to express learnings individually. I thoroughly enjoyed each philosophy teaching & film. Learned new ways to see things.

Dr. Vincenzo's style of teaching was extremely helpful and enjoyable.  He provided excellent examples to help students when discussing various schools of thought and disciplines of philosophy and used motion pictures (in class) to show ideas in the text coming into being through the various characters.  I'd strongly recommend his class to anyone!
He did a great job trying to teach a very challenging course. I thnk doing writings each week instead of at the end of the semester would be ideal.

Dr. Vincenzo was a good teacher and I believe very passionate about philosophy and it's teachings.  I enjoyed the class material and the discussions and I really have a new found respect for philosophy.  I would recommend this class to others.

The readings were complex and difficult. The movies were great and a new way of teaching philosophy that I had not thought alot about before. I left the class with a thorough understanding and enjoyment of the material.  I would highly recommend this class.
Excellent!

Great professor only if you like to be challenged. Most students who do not like him, are simply there to just take a test and get a grade, vs being challenged to think beyond their limits. His approach is different, however, he's attempting to provoke individual thought and for the student to not follow the crowd. He's a caring professor as well.
ridiculously boring but super easy! he tells you exactly whats going to be on his tests at the review and his tests are multiple choice.
He is a very good teacher. I am glad that he is still at Walsh!

Talks about his past travel experiences for most of the time. Means well in his approach (or rather nonapproach)of teaching.He is afraid it seems to actually teach a class- therefore he is very experimental. If you can get past all the day dreaming going on he has some good points.z.z. although.z.z.
No Comments

Lab portion of basic Bio course. lab manualmandatory, 30$. Prof seems knowledgeable about content areas but mostly "over it" AFA teaching his students. Prepare to teach yourself. He will not explain anything explicitly including his grading policy but also course content (outside of 10 min lecture thatll confuse or put you to sleep). Frustrating.

Pr. Enea may not be the best lecturer but he is really knowledgeable about every topic of his subject, he is always happy to answer/help with all the questions you may have. Very kind and understanding, takes extra time to go over the material. His exams are hard, but if you review your notes and read the book, you'd be ok!

He was boring and the class was not engaging. He knows what he's speaking about but he doesn't hold the student's interest. He was quite rude sometimes and he would space out on the class. I wouldn't recommend anyone taking class unless they have patience and can actually teach themselves.
Super great professor, extremely understanding when it comes to passing...

Do not hesitate to take a class that Prof. Patrizia teaches. She is literally the most caring professor I have ever had and goes above and beyond to ensure that students understand the material. She is caring, fun, engaging and very organized. The course had a lot of work but Prof. Patrizia made it fun all along. She is very understanding.

I had Professor Di Vincenzo for IT 1000 and I really enjoyed the course. She's so nice, caring, and an overall amazing prof and human being. Although the course was really condensed and we had to learn a lot in a short period of time (as it was a summer course), she was very flexible and managed everything so well. I highly recommend her!

Very kind, funny and helpful prof. Its easy to get A+ in this class because her assignments and quizzes are very doable. She is knowledgeable and approachable. Sometimes she gets feisty if students are not attending the lectures or if they are using words too advanced compared to what she taught us (understandable). I can't recommend her enough! :)

She was amazing, easy course if you actually do the work and put in the effort, and very enjoyable. Professor Di Vincenzo is so incredibly caring and I was truly grateful to have her as my Professor. She is very accessible outside class and responds to emails very quickly, she is truly a great professor and I would take the course again if I could.

Excellent, caring, demanding prof. Will check your homework. Insists on attendance and participation. Be prepared to do a lot of work. If so, you will receive a good mark. Best language prof I've had a York (out of 7 so far).

Patrizia is the kindest and most caring prof. She always makes sure we are caught up and understanding our work. She does her best to make sure everyone passes with a good grade and praises her students when they do well. The best prof to teach a foreign language without making you feel stupid when you mess up! She has very good teaching tactics!

Patrizia is the nicest prof I've had. She's so understanding and kind. She also makes sure her students understand everything and doesn't make you look stupid when you screw up. 10/10 person. The course is as hard as you'd expect a foreign language course to be. Just make sure you study for the tests :)
Such an incredible professor whos so passionate and dedicated to helping her students succeed. She makes learning so enjoyable, would definitely recommend!
Best Professor Ever!! She really cares about all her students! Would definitely recommend!!

One of the best professors at York University. Her class was the only class that made me cry when it ended. Words cannot describe how amazing, caring and understanding she is. You can easily get an +A if you do the homework and attend to the class. She is a knowledgeable professor and really passionate about what she is doing.

An amazing professor who cares a lot about her students. She gets really upset when students aren't doing well because she puts so much effort into teaching us and making us practice properly over and over. I am not Italian, but worked really hard and loved learning the language, she gave all the tools needed to do well. She's an incredible person.

Energetic, caring, and a generally amazing professor. I don't know how she manages 3-4 other jobs while still having energy to teach. She makes nice small talk conversations and makes everyone feel comfortable. Workload can be rigorous at times but if you do your homework and show up to class every time theres no reason you cant get an A
she helped me out a lot. The class was hard, but if you pay attention and actually attend lectures its easier. Group work was the only downside. She is a very understanding prof.

She's a good prof. She gives you all the tools to succeed and it's up to you to study if you want a good grade. She's quite moody, and can be rude when asked questions . When she is in a good mood she's cool though. Would still take this class again.

Overall outstanding prof. Put in some effort and you'll get an A. Pop quizzes are easy and you can generally expect when they will happen. The worksheets, assignments and pop quizzes are a good method of testing your knowledge in Italian.
She really cares about her students and gives great worksheets. If you want to learn Italian and have never done it before, she is the one you need.

Excellent professor! She genuinely cares for her students and gives a lot of practice for all tests. If you pay attention in class, this course is easy and manageable. She is very approachable and does her best to ensure that you get full on all the smaller class tests. 100% would recommend if you are someone with absolutely no knowledge of Italian
She can be Moody. But, overall she's a good prof. She gives people chances to finish their work in class and she is a very lenient marker.

At the beginning of the semester Di Vincenzo seemed like an overall great professor, but as the semester continued she became quite cruel. She had a habit of yelling at multiple students in front of the class making it an uncomfortable learning environment. One pro: pop quizzes that may help boost your grade. Look elsewhere for an IT1000 prof.
Loved her as a person. As a prof, not so much. She yells at students (quite rudely) and is often short-tempered.  Not good for students who are just begging to learn the language.

She is an amazing prof and person! This course is  only tough if you don't like to work hard. She makes all her tests very easy and tells you everything that will be on it. She takes time to explain the language and tells stories to help brighten up the class. If you don't do the work don't expect to do well.

One of the most incredible professors i've come across in the span of my education. Her teaching style is super effective, super clear, and she genuinely cares about the success of her students. She worries when the class does poorly and she makes sure to review anything the class didn't understand. Plus, she prepares you for the test very well!

Patrizia is very approachable! She isn't just there to teach and then leave, genuinely cares about students and how to help them succeed. She prepares you well for tests and gives time to do homework in class. However, if you are not interested in learning the language or willing to put in the effort -dont bother. She can only do so much for you.
Genuinely cares about the education you receive and whether or not you can use what you've learned.
Good Prof :)
A great teacher that keeps you engaged and ensures you understand the material. She's very helpful and has great personal notes as well to help students.

Awesome teacher! If you wanna learn Italian seriously, she's the best! Only had good and fun moments with her! She really insists on homework but trust me, it's only gonna benefit you! On final exam you will be:"I'm glad I got all that work done all year long!"

She seems very down to earth and chill on the first day of class, then hits your hard with homework. There was a lot of repition and "line writing" in her class, but it was helpful. Many people complained she was incoherent, but if you are willing to put in the time and effort, she will be upfront and honest about what you need to do to succeed.
sick prof and shes entertaining when she told us stories! LOL

As far as Prof's go Patrizia is pretty good. Her tests are reasonable and she is very understanding but like any language course, if you aren't willing to put in the time, or just aren't good at languages, then avoid the course. She doesn't give away A's

Hes not that bad of a teacher.  He uses the text book alot so come with it EVERDAY! If you pay attention you should have no problem. Gives extra credit which is a plus. A teacher you should really look into.
Perfect

Mele is a really nice guy. hes funny. hes accent is really funny and makes funny spontaneous comments all the time. his class is easy. i did not pay much attention and ended up with a B. His tests are a little weird but you'll be fine if you take him.

Really nice and intelligent guy, but he has a heavy Italian accent so it can be difficult to understand him - which makes class a bit tedious sometimes. Tests are easy if you study and pay attention. You could easily get by without the textbook if you take good notes but I'd recommend using it to study anyway.

Professor Mele is a really nice guy, but sometimes his notes are not so clear. He says in the beginning attendance is not mandatory but he takes it everyday. His exams are not difficult but you have to read the textbook because less than half of the tests are from his notes. Kind of a boring class but not too challenging. Always lets you out early!

Such a sweet guy. Always gives you a chance to fix your mistakes like forgetting to hand in an assignment. she is the best teacher ever.
